title: 웹 품목 저장의 공유 EXE 데이터 보존
masterIdentity: Product.ProdKey; master has no year/week scope; all years' ledgers preserved

actions.name: CREATE
actions.write: Product validated values, CountryFlower by native Country.isSelectFlower, independent SteamOf1Box, audit fields and SystemActionLog atomically

actions.name: EDIT
actions.write: Only explicitly changed Product fields; stale expected snapshot rejects; CountryFlower updated only on classification change; independent box stems preserved unless explicit; readback and audit atomically

actions.name: BULK
actions.write: Existing web bulk fields and explicit independent SteamOf1Box; no automatic factor multiplication

criteria.source: Actual FormProductAdd.btnSave_Click/ClassProduct.Insert/Update; native independent box stems and country classification
criteria.defaults: Existing null/zero preserved; absent edit fields unchanged. New required name/country/flower/units must be valid. Numeric inputs finite nonnegative with DB precision. No stock write or recalc.
criteria.concurrency: Active ProdKey locked, full editable expected snapshot compared, stale/missing reject409. Unit changes require explicit confirmation; no historical quantities conversion.
criteria.webFeatures: Country/flower buttons, shared photos, bulk editing and SystemActionLog preserved. Not EXE feature parity.
criteria.downstream: Product name/classification/unit changes intentionally affect subsequent reads; existing OrderDetail/ShipmentDetail Amount/Vat/isFix/ShipmentDate/ShipmentFarm/StockHistory/ProductStock/Estimate/WebProfitReport preserved.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025/2026 same42-01 Order/Shipment and quote/profit/stock sentinel rows remain identical under Product save
